notes: Faculty data comes from each professor's profile page on aui.ma (teacher-bio pages); school details from each school's page and the Language Center page.
Phone numbers shown as 'ext. NNNN' are internal extensions; from outside dial +212 535-86 followed by the extension (e.g. ext. 2114 -> +212 535-862-114).
null means the field is not published on the profile. 'TBA' means the profile itself says office hours are to be announced.
Office hours are as posted on the website and may be for a past semester; confirm with the professor or the office door.

Known website issues: Eda Orhun's profile repeats Adil Akaaboune's extension and email, so those were left out; Frances Loustau-Williams has two profiles with different offices (Building 7/102 and Building 8/102).

departments.name: School of Business Administration

location.notes: School office, project manager and administrative assistant are in Building 11; some faculty offices are in Buildings 8B, 10, 16 (NAB) and 6.

departments.description: Business and management education at undergraduate, graduate and executive levels; BBA program accredited by EFMD (EPAS).
programs: Bachelor of Business Administration (concentrations: Finance, Management, Marketing, Logistics, International Business, AI and Analytics for Business)
Master of Science in Digital Marketing and Analytics
services: Academic advising (every student is assigned an academic advisor who approves degree plans and course registration)
SBA Internship Program (INT 4301, mandatory for graduation; internship agreement, convention de stage, report and presentation guidelines)
Program sheets and recommended degree pathway
Research & Publications
Experiential learning and student engagement
Trading room, case-study and simulation-based teaching
Exchange / study abroad with partner institutions
Executive education
